pictures.name: LV1-Hillside-Crowd
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A wide green grassy hillside above the blue Sea of Galilee in late afternoon, a huge crowd of first-century villagers in earth-toned robes and headscarves spreading up the slope, men, women, elders, families. In the middle distance, a man in a plain cream robe with a dark brown outer cloak, shoulder-length dark hair, seen only from behind, his face never visible, standing with a few friends and looking out over the crowd. Golden low sun, long blue shadows on the grass, the lake shining behind. Main subject, the crowd and the lone figure, in the middle. Vast, hungry, hopeful. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: LV2-Boys-Basket
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. On the grassy hillside, a kind bearded fisherman in his thirties with a weathered face, in a faded blue tunic (Andrew), kneels beside a barefoot boy of about ten with curly black hair, in a short undyed wool tunic with a rope belt, holding a small woven reed basket. The boy holds the basket open: five round, rough brown barley loaves and two small dried fish. The boy looks up with a shy, open face. Behind them, the blurred crowd on the slope. Warm gold light on the bread, deep blue shade. The basket in the middle of the frame. Small, humble, tender. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: LV3-Gives-Thanks
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. On the grassy hillside at golden hour, a man in a plain cream robe with a dark brown outer cloak, shoulder-length dark hair, seen only from behind, his face never visible, stands holding the round barley loaves up a little in both hands, head lifted toward the sky in thanks. Before him, hundreds of people sit in groups on the grass, faces turned toward him, warm and expectant. The bearded fisherman in the faded blue tunic and a barefoot boy of about ten with curly black hair, in a short undyed wool tunic with a rope belt, holding a small woven reed basket stand near. Sunset gold on the bread and sky, deep blue shadows. The loaves and his raised hands in the middle. Quiet, grateful, holy. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: LV4-Bread-Passed
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Close among the seated crowd on the hillside: many hands passing torn pieces of barley bread and small fish from person to person, an old woman in a dark headscarf smiling as she takes a piece, a young father breaking bread for his daughter, a weathered farmer laughing. Baskets moving through the crowd. Warm gold evening light, deep blue shadows, the grass glowing. The passing hands in the middle. Plenty, joy, sharing. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: LV5-Twelve-Baskets
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Dusk on the grassy hillside above the darkening lake. Twelve woven reed baskets stand in a row on the grass, each heaped with leftover pieces of brown barley bread. The bearded fisherman in the faded blue tunic and two other friends in simple robes gather the last pieces, amazed. The crowd is drifting home along the slope. Last gold light on the bread, deep blue evening shadows, a first star. The baskets in the middle. Abundance, wonder, quiet. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: LV6-Today-Grace-Table
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A modern family kitchen at dinnertime, painted in the same sacred oil style: a wooden table with steaming potatoes, a bowl of greens and a loaf of bread. A white-haired grandmother in a cardigan gently rests her hand on a teenage grandson’s wrist as he reaches for the bread; around the table, parents and a young girl bow their heads, hands folded. A small crucifix on the wall behind. Warm gold lamplight over the table, deep blue window light of evening. The grandmother and the bread in the middle. Tender, funny, loving. No text, no letters, no logos.
